provenance.selection: One meeting; 6 um+6 uh+4 annotated backchannel mm-hmm+2 annotated backchannel hmm+3 laughter+3 ordinary speech; deterministic salted SHA ordering within speaker, speaker round-robin; windows nonoverlapping. Positive and ordinary-speech windows require no other annotated voice event in at least0.5s padded window; expand up to1.25s until next other speaker. Backchannel/laugh windows retain recorded overlap. No audio-listening or model-output selection.
scope_limits: Corpus-authored lexical references and dialogue-act labels; these are not independently adjudicated filler-removal truth.
Word boundaries may be forced-aligned; report approximate interval overlap, not precisely validated boundary F1.
Only one meeting and four speakers; no independent speaker/session generalization estimate.
Reference-filler set is lexical uh/um only. Meaningful backchannels are explicit hard negatives; other filler families unlabelled.
Other-speaker overlap marked; absence of annotated uh/um is not exhaustive negative validation.
provenance.source_availability: Original HTTPS and HTTP hosts timed out locally; downloaded pinned mirror, verified against mirror Git LFS SHA256. Mirror claims unchanged official content; original byte parity not independently verified.
